title: Workflow Editor
description: Visually orchestrate workflows: drop nodes from the left palette, click a node then another to connect them, and edit node properties on the right.

palette.title: Node Palette
palette.hint: Click a palette item to add a node; drag nodes to move; click a node to select and start a connection; press Delete to remove the selected node; click a line to delete it.

toolbar.connecting: Connecting: click a target node to complete, or click the source node again to cancel

properties.title: Node Properties
properties.name: Name
properties.namePlaceholder: Give the node a recognizable name

empty.canvasDesc: Click a node in the left palette to start orchestration.
empty.noSelectionDesc: Click a node in the canvas to edit its properties.
